rapport_notes: Excellent -- attentive, careful about spelling details correctly, and gracefully resolved a fee objection.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "What are your biggest concerns and what are the most important things you want answers to on this call today"
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised pricing plus wanting furniture undamaged; rep gave one reassurance ('we are definitely well equipped... rest assured that, you know, we'll take care of everything') and pivoted to quid pro quo without a follow-up question.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "So, would you like to go ahead and get on the schedule today?" ... customer: 'Yes please, yes.' -- rep paused for confirmation rather than re-pitching.

top_strength: Skillfully resolved a trip-fee objection by finding a legitimate branch-reassignment waiver (switching to South Austin branch), turning a stalling price objection into a fully booked, satisfied customer.
coaching_note: The initial furniture-care concern could have been dug into with one more follow-up question before pivoting to quid pro quo -- an easy two-layer moment was skipped.
